ModMetaData.name: GateRim SG-1
ModMetaData.author: Diablood
ModMetaData.description:
GateRim SG-1 brings the Stargate SG-1 universe to RimWorld.
Current development scope: - Jaffa xenotype foundation - Custom Jaffa physiology gene without forced body shape - Jaffa longevity set to 150% lifespan expectancy - French translations for the stabilized Jaffa content - Goa'uld faction - Jaffa pawn kinds - Ma'Tok staff weapon - Zat'nik'tel - Generic Jaffa armor
Biotech is required for xenotype support. This is an early development version.
